layers.name: Door
layers.notes: Hinge on its left edge. T135 (b): move its anchor to the middle of its left edge with Pan Behind (Y), capture practice2b-anchor.json, then Edit > Undo

layers.name: Needle
layers.notes: Hinge at the middle of its bottom edge

layers.name: Gauge
layers.notes: Rotation 0 → 90: the rest key is the one at 0

layers.name: Lid
layers.notes: Its pivot sits outside the shape (row 23)

layers.name: Wobble
layers.notes: Anchor Point keys: never a candidate (row 4); its place is at 0 s, before the keys move it

layers.name: Sign
layers.notes: Centred text: its pivot starts on the baseline, between places (the baseline case)

layers.name: Plaque
layers.notes: Scale 200%: places in its own space (row 17)

layers.name: Pop
layers.notes: Scale 0 → 100: the rest key is the one at 100 (the shrunk case)

layers.name: Seal
layers.notes: Collapse Transformations on: never a candidate (row 10)

layers.name: Tile
layers.notes: Position and Scale keys, starting 6 frames apart so they aren't a skill 3 properties group

layers.name: Caption
layers.notes: Opacity 20 → 100, so it isn't a skill 1 candidate

layers.name: Row B
layers.notes: No keys: a static group member (filter 1)

by_hand.parented: T135 (a): add a null, parent Tile, Caption and Stamp to it with the pick whip in the Parent column, capture practice2b-parented.json at 0 s, then Edit > Undo
by_hand.anchor: T135 (b): move Door's anchor to the middle of its left edge with Pan Behind (Y), capture practice2b-anchor.json at 0 s, then Edit > Undo
